messages:
jamie: Heads-up — auditor asked for a compact evidence set for last week's vuln triage (CVE-2025-1234) + the RBAC change to inference-admin. Need PRs, deploy manifests, auth logs, KMS access, and the triage notes. Can owners drop artifacts here?

alex: I own the RBAC PRs. I'll link the PR, diff, and the deployment window. Also confirm approvers and canary snapshot.

maria: I can pull authz/session logs from Splunk. Do they want per-user detail or an aggregated summary for the change window?

chris-auditor: Per-user for the change window is preferred, plus a short summary. We also need KMS decrypt/decryptAttempt events for the CMK(s) involved and the key policy snapshot at rotation time.

ravi: Oncall here — we correlated an alert during the rollout/rollback window. I have the incident timeline and investigator notes ready to attach.

jamie: Suggested deliverables: 1) PR link + approvers 2) deployment manifest + canary snapshot 3) Splunk exports (per-user) 4) KMS access log slices + key policy snapshot 5) vuln triage notes + remediation artifacts (SBOM diff, patched deps).

alex: PR => https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521
alex: Approvers: maria, jamie. Deployed 2025-03-12T02:14Z -> canary -> full at 02:27Z (rollback in between, see notes).

maria: Splunk query I'm using (exporting CSV):
```
index=auth source=prod action=role.change user=* earliest=03/12/2025:02:00:00 latest=03/12/2025:03:00:00
| stats count by _time, user, action, role
```
I'll drop the CSV to /compliance/evidence/1778012345/ with a SHA256 hash.

ravi: Incident timeline gist:
- 02:20Z: Canary showed uptick in 5xx for inference service
- 02:23Z: Auto-rollback triggered (deployment platform)
- 02:25Z: Manual investigation started, revert PR #4521 applied
- 02:40Z: Prod stable, monitoring OK
I'll attach the investigator notes and paged alerts.

jamie: KMS bit: which CMK was used? @maria can you pull CloudKMS logs (decrypt/decryptAttempt) for key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/inference/cryptoKeys/ingress-key-v3 and slice for the 02:00-03:00Z window?

maria: grabbing it now. Auditor: do you need the raw logs or a signed export bundle? We can provide a presigned S3 with a SHA256 hash for integrity.

chris-auditor: Presigned S3 + SHA256 is fine. Also include the KMS key policy snapshot and rotation metadata (who rotated, when, and the rotation ticket/PR).

jamie: I'll own the evidence manifest (spreadsheet) with filenames, URLs, hashes, and short descriptions. Expect an initial bundle by EOD PST. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy 4521 -> canary succeeded -> full failed -> rollback executed by team

alex: One more ask from my side — auditor wants proof that the RBAC change was tested. I have e2e test run logs and a test matrix; will attach to the evidence folder.

jamie: Great. If folks drop filenames/URLs below I'll add them to the manifest. tagging @chris-auditor for visibility.

chris-auditor: Thanks — that should cover it. Quick follow-up: include the vulnerability scoring rationale and evidence that the transitive dependency was patched (diff from SBOM).

jamie: Noted. Adding vuln scan report and SBOM diff to the bundle.

alex: Uploaded e2e logs: s3://redwood-compliance/1778012345/e2e-logs.zip (will send presigned link and hash).

maria: Uploaded Splunk CSV + KMS slice: s3://redwood-compliance/1778012345/authz-and-kms.zip (presigned link to follow).

ravi: Incident notes uploaded: s3://redwood-compliance/1778012345/incident-timeline.md

jamie: Manifest updated with those links + SHA256s. I'll push a signed manifest (PGP) into the same folder and ping the auditor when ready.

chris-auditor: Received. I'll review and follow up if I need deeper traces or raw SIEM exports. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

jamie: Thanks team — closing loop after auditor ack.
